name: Breathless: Will You Understand Me?
source: Shy high school student Aki Murakami has an unusual ability to turn invisible when she holds her breath. Things get interesting when school idol Megumi Amano finds out her secret, and the two discover that they have more in common than they thought.
translation: 害羞的高中生村上亚希拥有一种不寻常的能力，当她屏住呼吸时就会隐形。当学校偶像天野惠发现自己的秘密时，事情变得有趣，两人发现他们的共同点比他们想象的要多。
